paragraphs: A Class I recall is underway for Wow Bao cheeseburger bao buns sold in eight states due to undeclared allergens [1]. The 10-ounce boxes with "USE BY 10.01.27 LOT #26243 EST 40001" were distributed in Alabama, Colorado, Connecticut, Georgia, Iowa, Maine, Massachusetts, and Michigan; consumers with this product should not eat it [1].

Grand Strand Sandwich Company is recalling four frozen breakfast sandwich products—Lunch Box Bacon Egg and Cheese Biscuit, Lunch Box Sausage Egg and Cheese Biscuit, Lunch Box Jumbo Sausage Biscuit, and Lunch Box Chicken Sausage Biscuit—due to potential Listeria monocytogenes contamination [5]. Prime Food Processing LLC is recalling 225 cases of Dried Herring Fish because the product was not adequately eviscerated, which violates New York State regulations and poses a risk of Clostridium botulinum spores [2].

Shanghai San Niu Food Co., Ltd. is recalling Sanniu Evergreen Biscuits and Sanniu Salt and Pepper Soda Biscuits because they may contain undeclared milk, and the soda biscuits may also contain undeclared shrimp [4]. As the holiday season continues, the USDA reminds consumers that leftovers require careful handling to stay safe [7].
